embedding_storage.query: SELECT count(*) AS rows,min(created_at) AS oldest,max(created_at) AS newest,count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at > NOW()-INTERVAL '1 day') AS writes_24h,pg_total_relation_size('content_embeddings') AS total_bytes,pg_relation_size('content_embeddings') AS heap_bytes FROM content_embeddings

pipeline_24h_metrics.query: SELECT pipeline_key,trigger_source,status,count(*) AS n,min(started_at) AS first,max(finished_at) AS last,percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds) AS p50_s,percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_seconds) AS p95_s FROM pipeline_runs WHERE started_at>NOW()-INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY pipeline_key,trigger_source,status

embedding_indexes.query: SELECT schemaname,tablename,indexname,indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename IN ('content_embeddings','embedding')

rows.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX embedding_pkey ON intelligence.embedding USING btree (ref)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX content_embeddings_pkey ON public.content_embeddings USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX content_embeddings_source_type_source_id_key ON public.content_embeddings USING btree (source_type, source_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_ce_keywords ON public.content_embeddings USING gin (top_keywords)
CREATE INDEX idx_content_embeddings_cat ON public.content_embeddings USING btree (category_content)
